description: This file implements a custom stream provider adapter factory and associated classes for testing Orleans EventHub stream caches with cache list creation, pressure monitoring, and command execution.

classes.name: EHStreamProviderWithCreatedCacheListAdapterFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing EventHub stream caches with testing enhancements, including cache pressure detection.

classes.name: CacheFactoryForTesting
classes.description: A nested class that creates test cache instances for queues with pressure monitoring capabilities.

classes.name: QueueCacheForTesting
classes.description: A subclass of EventHubQueueCache used for testing cache pressure responses.

methods.name: CreateCacheFactory
methods.description: Creates a cache factory with test configurations for pressure monitoring.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes commands, notably to check if any created cache is under pressure.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to instantiate the adapter factory with configuration options.
